results.title: 'Not Matter Of One Lady, It's About PM': Delhi HC Issues Notice To CJP Activists Over Deepfake
results.description: A woman has alleged that AI-generated deepfake images depicting her in an explicit manner alongside PM Narendra Modi were circulated during CJP-led demonstrations

results.title: After Chirag Paswan, NDA Ally Upendra Kushwaha Seeks ECI Clarification On SIR Row
results.description: Kushwaha’s remarks came a day after he had initially declined to comment on the controversy when questioned by reporters in Patna. He had then said the issue concerned the Election Commission and that differences of opinion were not unusual, noting that disagreements could occur between individuals.

results.title: Fist fights in J-K Assembly as CM moves statehood resolution
results.description: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah introduced a resolution in the assembly demanding the urgent restoration of full statehood for the union territory. The resolution, which referenced previous autonomy resolutions, led to intense protests and 'ugly scenes' from opposition BJP members, resulting in the adjournment of the House. Abdullah highlighted the unfulfilled promise by the Government of India regarding statehood after delimitation and elections.
